notes.title: hack_me 2 release!
notes.notes:
The next part of hack_me is already in Steam.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/602890 

hack_me 2 is a story about hacker-beginner, who is going to confront to new World Order, where is no place for personal secrets. In this game you'll see, how real-life hackers work. You'll learn how to use command prompt, SQL-injectors, remote control utilities and brute-force software. An log cleaner, of course.

notes.title: Release on linux
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that hack_me is now available for play on the Linux operating system!

Our plan is now to work on bug fixes in Chapter 2, to release the game on MacOs and to develop new chapters!

Thank you for helping us make the game better!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Second Chapter
notes.notes:
The long-awaited update was released!
Many bugs have been fixed and was added some useful things.

A more detailed list of changes:
[list]
    [*] Added second chapter
    [*] Added official soundtracks, added and changed sounds
    [*] Added second type of menu
    [*] Added panel, showing the current goal. It is located at the top-right, only in Chapter 2.
    [*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Game content on release
notes.notes:
Warning to all buyers!

Game will be released only with 1st chapter. It takes about 15 minutes to complete it. A week later after release (10-15 of November) we'll released 2nd chapter with more game content (about 40 minutes).
Dont buy game on release If you dont want to wait for missions.

Thank you for understanding!
